title: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th edition (BSC5)
locator: catalog.dat fixed-width columns (Vmag 102:107, RA J2000 75:83, Dec J2000 83:90)
note: Primary star catalogue for the issue #122 dynamic night sky. Stars fainter than V = 7.0 are dropped because the naked-eye limiting-magnitude chain (fnc_calculateLimitingMagnitude) clamps at 7.0 and BSC5 is only complete to about 7.0. Positions are J2000.0; precession is applied at run time by fnc_getStarCatalog. The 10-character Name column truncates, so visual doubles that collapse to one string (e.g. 36 Oph A/B) are disambiguated with the HR number by tools/validation/gen_star_catalog.py.
